explanation: Erdős #1070, first part: estimate f(n), the minimum independence number of an n-point planar unit-distance graph, posed as lim f(n)/n. The limit exists by subadditivity and Fekete. The site gives bounds 0.22936n ≤ f(n) ≤ (2/7)n. The definition of f matches the site's reformulation. The statement is faithful and open.
